request.spec:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each sheet now has its own "today" date. `bin/e2e` passes.

**What changed**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V2__sheet_today.sql`, adds a required `today` date column to the `sheet` table. Sheets that already exist get the date they were created.
- **Server:** a new sheet starts with the real date as its today. Loading a sheet now returns its `today` as well as its id. A new endpoint, `PUT /api/sheets/{id}/today`, changes the date. A missing or badly formed date is refused and nothing is saved, and changing the date of a sheet that was never loaded gets a 404.
- **Shared helper:** `SheetService.today(sheetId)` returns a sheet's today. The front end keeps the same value in `Session.today()`. Future features that depend on the date should read one of these instead of the clock.
- **Screen:** the session bar shows the date (`sheet-today`), with a date field (`sheet-today-input`) and a save button (`sheet-today-save`). If the save is refused, an error appears (`sheet-error`); it goes away when you edit the field, save again or load a sheet. Another user sees the new date after reloading the sheet.

**Worth knowing**
- **Nothing else uses the date yet.** The app has no other date-dependent features or default dates, so there was nothing to switch over from the real clock. The only remaining use of the real clock is setting a new sheet's starting date and its creation time.
- **No audit record is written** when the date changes. The request didn't define one and the test doesn't expect one; if you want it, it needs an event name and field order.
- **A blank date is refused** with the error, rather than resetting to the real date. The test doesn't cover this.
